head: jar
reading: ordinary closing word of a seal used to stamp goods; takes any qualifier
would_support: new sealing batches keep the jar as commonest head on impressions (>=40% of headed sealing texts)
would_kill: a new sealing batch (>=50 texts) with jar texts below chance on impressions, or its qualifier set splitting into closed sub-registers

head: arrow
reading: closing word of a fish title: fish word (+ three) + arrow; on seals used to stamp goods
would_support: >=50% of new arrow texts carry a fish word; none takes W90/91

head: box527
reading: variant of the ordinary seal ending used with the pincer or fish title; never with a numeral; Lothal-leaning
would_support: new box527 texts keep pincer/fish qualifiers and no numeral
would_kill: >=3 new box527 texts with a numeral directly before it

head: W151
reading: same ending as the jar, kept for seals not found stamped
would_support: still no W151 impression after the next ~200 sealings
would_kill: >=3 W151 texts on new sealings, or a qualifier split from the jar at held-out sites

head: W156
reading: short formula ending three + W156 with a one-word middle; incised tablets and small steatite seals
would_support: new incised tablets keep S3 + W156
would_kill: W156 on a moulded tablet with the leaf-tree qualifier

head: W154/158
reading: same formula ending as W156 with leaf-tree W806; moulded tablets and bar seals; Harappa
would_kill: incised W154/158 tablets taking the S3 epithet

head: W226
reading: short fixed title tall two + four-stroke fish closing Mohenjo-daro steatite seals
would_support: new W226 seals keep T2 before it
would_kill: W226 seals with middles of >=3 signs in >=5 of the next 10

head: W236
reading: opener + connective + W236 (+W400) with no middle: a fixed formula, not a personal seal
would_support: new W236 texts of <=3 signs with the connective
would_kill: W236 after a free middle of >=2 signs in >=3 new texts

head: W615/617
reading: man-with-staff phrase ending 142 + 617; copper-tablet and bar-seal form of the ordinary ending; Mohenjo-daro
would_kill: W615/617 with the T3 or S3 epithet

head: W700
reading: counted unit of the Harappa tablets: tall 2-4 + W700 = so many units; not a seal ending
would_support: any new Harappa tablet ending in W700 has a tall numeral before it
would_kill: a set of W700 seals with free middles

head: W595
reading: rare seal closer replacing the jar (pre-closer, S288)
would_support: new W595 seals without the jar
would_kill: W595 + jar in the same text in >=2 new finds

head: mjar
reading: the jar as a member inside a compound (96% of tokens medial)
would_kill: >=10 new texts ending in a marked jar

head: W400
reading: a headed text with the head left off, closed only by the receipt suffix; a tablet word
would_support: new W400-only tablets match headed tablet texts minus the head
would_kill: a W400-only text type with its own qualifier set

head: W90/91
reading: person suffix after the jar only (97 vs 72; 0 after other heads)
would_kill: W90/91 after the arrow or W700 in >=3 new texts

head: none
reading: long middles, numerals, quantity phrases, second units; pots, bangles, copper tablets, foreign seals
would_support: new Gulf seals keep no-head above 50%
would_kill: a held-out site where no-head texts are short and numeral-free
